claim_ceiling: REPRODUCED tier, not ACCEPTED. Surviving, independently reproduced claim: for corpora WITHOUT a resolved citation graph, dense multilingual-e5 (per-language center-projection + PCA-64 + L2) is a better TEXT-ONLY citation-heritage proxy than the 4 pre-registered lexical TF-IDF baselines. Identical matched self-pair-free ORIG (606 pos / 834 neg): dense_cp64 = 0.718928 vs best text-only regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7 = 0.586568, margin +0.132359, 2000-resample paired bootstrap 95% CI [+0.092521, +0.170932] (reproduced bit-for-bit). DIRECT hard-negative matched (5255 / 6008): dense_cp64 = 0.692423 vs 0.561596, margin +0.130827. Scope limits that MUST travel with the claim: (1) the advantage is over LEXICAL TF-IDF only; no non-dense neural text baseline was tested; (2) absolute proxy strength is modest (~0.72 ORIG / ~0.69 DIRECT) and these are citation-relatedness AUCs on a curated pair set, not end-user utility; (3) dense remains INFERIOR to the full-dim binary citation Jaccard on DIRECT (0.6924 vs 0.7718) and is redundant where shared citations exist (Jaccard = 1.0 on SHARED>=1/SHARED>=2 by construction); (4) the eval-lane 'shared>=2 / dense>=0.75' gate is graph-degenerate and must not be used for dense promotion; the frozen comparator 0.7296 (with-self, mixed-relation, 1000/2000-sampled, non-repo peer state) is NOT bit-reproduced here (this run gives 0.7426 with-self / 0.7159 matched no-self) and could not be independently sourced in this environment; (5) frozen_spec.json was committed in the same commit as the results, so 'pre-registered before outcome' is a producer assertion git cannot confirm. No revival of the retracted 'dense beats citation features' claim. State tier fields correctly read evidence_tier=REPRODUCED, cycle_status=SUCCESSOR_RECOMMENDED, continue_recommended=false.
evidence_summary: Audit of legal-distance v36 (producer snapshot /tmp/lex_team HEAD 14a0904cbe256548a67cac1850543344220f2d2b, parent 0e4d25401bb9c99e467e89eb001f6009b246ba73; producer run 38051603155, re-tagged by audit run 38056432926). I rebuilt the dense pipeline from raw inputs with my own code (metadata_174k.json 173,963; dense checkpoints 2000-2023 covering 158,427; TF-IDF npy 175,440 x 128; citation_pairs_174k.json), implementing per-language centering, L2, eigh PCA-64, and an independent rank-based Mann-Whitney AUC. All committed result values reproduced to 1e-6: dense_cp64 ORIG matched no-self 0.718928; full_text_tfidf_light 0.530767; regeste_tfidf 0.485012; regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5 0.552138; regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.7 0.586568; cited_decisions_tfidf 0.715892; DIRECT dense 0.692423, best text 0.561596; SHARED2 dense 0.969845. The H1 2000-resample bootstrap CI reproduced exactly (mean 0.132212, lo 0.092521, hi 0.170932) using the experiment's own bootstrap_margin method (np.random.default_rng(42)). Ran the producer verification test with the non-repo graph absent: 22 passed / 0 failed / 1 skipped; Section B is a genuine raw-vector recompute (independent trapezoidal-ROC) and is not circular. Leakage probe: text-only reps are essentially independent of cited_decisions_tfidf (mean cosine 0.000-0.028) and hybrids correlate with their declared regeste/full_text components, so the text-only class is clean. Cross-checked commit a33d92d5 vs 14a0904c: H1b headline AUCs unchanged, only bootstrap digits moved, as the report states. Defects found are confined to the report markdown: section 2.1 H1 table reports regeste_tfidf 0.5759 and regeste_full_text_hybrid_0.5 0.5863, which appear in no committed artifact and contradict the committed JSON (true 0.4850 and 0.5521), overstating the text-only class and flipping regeste_tfidf from below chance to above chance; and section 2.4 'Reproduced exactly' overclaims against the frozen 0.7296 (no 1000/2000 sampling applied; this run yields 0.7426). Also noted: legal_distance/state/legal-distance.json was reconciled to canonical state/legal-distance.json + the new run, dropping 5 divergent historical entries that remain in git history. The committed JSON evidence, frozen spec, and verification test are valid; only the report/provenance text needs the D1-D3 corrections. Gate = REVISE; safe_to_integrate = false until D1-D3 are fixed (no experiment re-run needed).
